title: Decentralized Mahjong
tagline: Mahjong but decentralized with the option of betting. It stores logs in IPFS.
description: We're going to build P2P Mahjong, but you also have the option to bet Ethereum on your own games. It uses IPFS, Web3.storage etc.We're thinking of using IPFS for storing our game logs on web3.storage and 3ID Connect + IDX for identity management. We'll also be using ThreadDB for signalling when establishing the P2P connections. We're using the Ethereum network and smart contracts to facilitate betting on your own games.
